name: Designer
lede: Tightens layout rhythm and keeps the companion voice consistent across surfaces.

learnings.quote: Prefer optical centering over mathematical center for hero blocks.
Avoid engagement-bait closers; end with a direct optional follow-up.
Stagger hero reveals once; do not loop ambient motion on headings.

name: Creative director
lede: Shapes narrative arcs for features and names that feel human, not template.

learnings.quote: Trade generic feature names for verbs the user would say aloud.
Lead with outcome, not mechanism, in onboarding copy.
One strong metaphor beats three mixed ones in a single surface.

name: Frontend designer
lede: Ships tactile UI: depth, light, and motion that respect reduced-motion users.

learnings.quote: Layer glass with edge highlights, not flat translucent panels.
Keyboard focus rings must survive dark glassmorphism stacks.
When in doubt, add air before adding another column.

name: QA tester
lede: Treats every flow like a skeptical first-time user with a stopwatch.

learnings.quote: Verify empty, loading, and error states before declaring a feature done.
